levels.title: B1 · Threshold
levels.description: Handle everyday life in English: talk about your routine, experiences, plans and opinions, and understand clear standard English on familiar topics.
levels.descriptionMn: Өдөр тутмын амьдралд англи хэлээр харилцах: дадал, туршлага, төлөвлөгөө, санал бодлоо илэрхийлэх, танил сэдвээр тодорхой ярианы англи хэлийг ойлгох.
canDo: Understand the main points of clear speech on familiar topics like work, school and free time
Describe experiences, events, hopes and plans and briefly give reasons for opinions
Write simple connected texts and personal emails on familiar topics
Deal with most situations while travelling in an English-speaking area
Read short articles and messages and find the information you need

levels.title: B1+ · Beyond the everyday
levels.description: Go beyond familiar situations: tell stories with the right tenses, report what others said, write formal emails and follow longer articles and conversations.
levels.descriptionMn: Танил нөхцөл байдлаас хальж: зөв цагаар түүх ярих, бусдын үгийг дамжуулах, албан захидал бичих, урт нийтлэл, ярианы гол санааг ойлгох.
canDo: Tell a detailed story using narrative tenses and time linkers
Report what other people said, asked and suggested
Write clear formal and informal emails for different purposes
Follow longer conversations and articles on a wide range of everyday topics
Explain problems and give advice with appropriate modal verbs

levels.title: B2 · Vantage
levels.description: Communicate with fluency and spontaneity: understand news, opinion pieces and natural-speed speech, and argue a viewpoint with supporting reasons.
levels.descriptionMn: Чөлөөтэй, байгалийн хурдаар харилцах: мэдээ, нийтлэл, хэвийн хурдтай яриаг ойлгох, үндэслэлтэйгээр байр сууриа хамгаалах.
canDo: Understand the main ideas of complex texts on concrete and abstract topics
Interact with native speakers with a degree of fluency and spontaneity
Write clear, detailed opinion essays and reports giving reasons for and against
Understand most TV news, podcasts and films in standard English
Explain a viewpoint on a topical issue, giving the advantages and disadvantages of various options

levels.title: B2+ · Towards proficiency
levels.description: Refine accuracy and range: persuade, hedge, and adapt register; follow interviews, discussions and complex articles with confidence.
levels.descriptionMn: Нарийвчлал, үгсийн баялгаа сайжруулах: ятгах, зөөлрүүлж хэлэх, хэв маягаа тохируулах; ярилцлага, хэлэлцүүлэг, нарийн нийтлэлийг итгэлтэй ойлгох.
canDo: Follow extended discussions and interviews even when the structure is not clear
Use hedging and softening language to express opinions diplomatically
Write argumentative essays and professional reports with a clear structure
Switch between formal and informal register appropriately
Evaluate sources and arguments in news and opinion writing

levels.title: C1 · Effective operational proficiency
levels.description: Use English flexibly and effectively for social, academic and professional purposes: understand implicit meaning, discuss abstract ideas and write well-structured, detailed texts.
levels.descriptionMn: Нийгэм, эрдэм шинжилгээ, мэргэжлийн зорилгоор англи хэлийг уян хатан, үр дүнтэй ашиглах: далд утгыг ойлгох, хийсвэр санааг хэлэлцэх, нарийн бүтэцтэй бичвэр бичих.
canDo: Understand a wide range of demanding, longer texts and recognise implicit meaning
Express ideas fluently and spontaneously without much obvious searching for expressions
Use language flexibly and effectively for social, academic and professional purposes
Produce clear, well-structured, detailed text on complex subjects
Follow lectures, debates and native-speed conversations on abstract and professional topics
